title: Airwallex pricing - $0-$999+/month tiers plus per-transaction and FX fees
clean_text: Airwallex introduced a three-tier US pricing structure in November 2025: Explore (free if depositing $5,000+/month or holding a $10,000 balance, otherwise $29/month), Grow ($99/month), and Accelerate (from $999/month). On top of the subscription, domestic card transactions cost 1.65% + $0.30, international cards cost 3.40% + $0.30, and currency conversion carries a 0.5% markup over the interbank rate for major currencies (1.0% for others). Receiving money is free in most currencies and local transfers to 120+ countries are free, but a 0.3% fee on transfers received from non-owner accounts is not listed on the public pricing page.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription plus usage-based transaction fees
